summary: isSafeInteger requires a numeric integer within the inclusive range from -(2^53-1) to 2^53-1.
documentation: isSafeInteger requires a numeric integer within the inclusive range from -(2^53-1) to 2^53-1. Within this range, integers have an unambiguous exact Number representation; the method also rejects fractional values and nonnumbers without coercion.
returns: A Boolean indicating whether each value is a safe integer.
caution: JSON numeric parsing may already have rounded a larger identifier before this check. Preserve oversized identifiers as strings rather than assuming a false result can recover lost digits.
scenarios: Check integer counters before exact arithmetic in a browser tool.
Flag imported numeric identifiers that should use a string representation.
Validate a numeric quantity before passing it to an integer-only operation.
title: Check exact integer representation
problem: Return Number.isSafeInteger for each input value. Numeric strings, Booleans, null and fractional numbers are not safe integers for this problem.
hint: Use the non-coercing Number method, not a conversion followed by an integer test.
goal: Use Number.isSafeInteger() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
